lines.text: The LORD says He will sow Israel and Judah with the seed of man and of beast, and watch over them to build and to plant.
In those days people will stop quoting the saying about sour grapes, and each will die for his own iniquity.
The LORD will make a new covenant unlike the one made when He led their fathers out of Babylon.
In the new covenant the LORD puts His law on stone tablets, and He forgives iniquities and remembers their sins no more.
The city will be rebuilt from the tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate, and it will never again be uprooted or demolished.
